title: Ilimin tsabtace datti da ɗakin aiki mai tsaro

say: Barka da zuwa Ilimin Tsabtace Datti da Ɗakin Aiki Mai Tsaro, babi na 1 na wannan kwas ɗin.
Kafin ki haɗa komai, ki koyi dalilin da ya sa kowane kaya ke aiki, abin da ke cikin rumbunki, da yadda za ki kiyaye wannan ɗaki.

shots.label: Surfactant yana aiki
say: Dubi wannan wuri mai maiko. Ruwa shi kaɗai ba zai iya cire maiko ba, saboda mai da ruwa ba sa gauraye.
Wannan fesan yana ɗauke da surfactant, wato ƙwayar sinadari mai gefe ɗaya mai son ruwa da gefe ɗaya mai son mai.
Yayin da muke gogewa, maikon yana farfashewa ya zama ƙananan ɗigo da surfactant ya naɗe, sai su tafi da ruwa.

shots.label: Takardar gwajin pH
say: Ki kalli yadda takardar ke canza launi. Muna kwatanta ta da jadawalin.
Ma'aunin pH, wato ƙarfin tsami ko kaifi, yana farawa daga 0 zuwa 14. Ruwa tsantsa 7 ne, a tsakiya. Ƙasa da 7 tsami ne, sama da 7 kaifi ne.
Maiko yana buƙatar kaifi. Zoben datti a kwanon ban ɗaki yana buƙatar tsami. Ƙwayoyin cuta suna buƙatar maganin kashe su bayan an wanke.

shots.label: Lokaci: a bar shi kafin a kurkura
say: Kin ga agogo yana tafiya yayin da wurin yake a jike? Lokaci yana ɗaya daga cikin ƙarfi huɗu na tsabtacewa.
Sauran su ne sinadari, aiki kamar goge-goge, da zafi. Idan ɗaya ya ragu, dole wani ya ƙaru.
Idan rubutun maganin ban ɗakinki ya ce a bar shi minti 10, lokaci ne ke yin aikin.

shots.label: Bilicin da maganin asid
shots.banner: Kada ki haɗa bilicin da asid ko ammonia
say: Waɗannan kwalabe biyu a rabe suke: bilicin a gefe ɗaya, maganin ban ɗaki na asid a ɗaya gefen.
Bilicin da asid suna fitar da iskar chlorine. Bilicin da ammonia suna fitar da iskar chloramine mai guba. Duka biyun suna cutar da ido da huhu.

shots.label: Kostik soda (sodium hydroxide)
say: Wannan farin gari mai ɓawo-ɓawo shi ne kostik soda, wanda masana sinadarai ke kira sodium hydroxide. Yana kuma zuwa a ƙwayoyi.
Yana kashe tsamin LABSA, wato asid mai ruwan ƙasa mai duhu, kusan 96% mai aiki, wanda ke zama babban surfactant ɗinki.
Yana cin jiki kuma yana yin zafi sosai a cikin ruwa.

shots.label: Duba kayan da aka kawo

card.title: SLES na Bisi da aka kawo, 25 kg

say: Duk kayan da aka kawo suna hawa ma'auni. Bisi a Ibadan tana auna jarkarta ta SLES 70%, wanda ʼyan kasuwa ke kira texapon.
Cike, nauyinta kilogiram 26.4. Jarka ba komai kilogiram 1.4 ce, don haka tana da kilogiram 25.0.
Ki nemi takardar bayanin tsaro da takardar shaidar gwaji daga masu sayarwa. Babu takardu? Ki sayi kaɗan ki rubuta ba a san ƙarfinsa ba.

shots.label: Wuraren ajiya guda huɗu
say: Dubi wannan shiryayye. Kowace roba a rufe take kuma tana da rubutu, da tazara a fili tsakanin rukunai.
Asid suna zama tare: LABSA da citric acid. Masu kaifi suna zama tare: kostik soda da soda ash. Bilicin yana zama shi kaɗai.
Isopropyl alcohol da turare suna zuwa wuri na huɗu, nesa da zafi, soket na wuta da kowace wuta.

shots.label: A rufe, a ɗaga daga ƙasa
say: Ki kalli murfin ana rufe shi tam. Kostik soda yana jan ruwa daga iska ya dunƙule, don haka gari-gari a rufe suke kuma a ɗage daga ƙasa.
Kuma don Allah, kada ki taɓa ajiye kowane sinadari a kwalbar ruwa, kwalbar lemo ko robar abinci. Mutane sun sha sinadaran wanki daga kwalaben da suka saba da su.

shots.label: Gilashin ido, safar hannu, epron
say: Ga kayan kariyarki: gilashin kariya mai rufe ido duka, safar hannu ta roba mai kauri da epron, tare da riga mai dogon hannu da takalmi rufaffe.
Tabarau na rana ba zai hana fantsama daga gefe ba, kuma ba a iya maye ido.

shots.label: Tsarin ɗaki mai hanya ɗaya

card.title: Ɗakin Hauwa, 3 m da 4 m
rows: Cikawa da kayan da aka gama

say: Wannan teburin haɗi yana kusa da taga a buɗe, don hayaƙi da ƙura su fita waje.
Kaya suna tafiya hanya ɗaya: rumbu, aunawa, haɗawa, hutawa da gwaji, cikawa, sannan shiryayyen kayan da aka gama.
Babu wanda zai ɗauki ruwa mai kauri ya koma ya wuce wanda ke cika kwalabe, kuma ruwa mai tsabta yana kusa da kowane wurin da zai iya fantsama.

shots.label: Kostik soda a CIKIN ruwa
shots.banner: Kada ki taɓa zuba ruwa a kan kostik soda
say: Ki kalla: ɓawon yana shiga ruwan sanyi a hankali, kaɗan-kaɗan, kada a taɓa yin akasin haka. Kin ga zafi yana tashi?
Ki yi amfani da robar da ke jure zafi, kada ki taɓa amfani da aluminiyam, saboda kostik soda yana cinye shi.
LABSA ma cikin ruwa ake zuba shi, ana juyawa. Kuma ki rubuta suna a kowane bokiti, ko da na awa ɗaya ne kawai.

shots.label: Ruwa mai gudu da wanke ido
shots.banner: Ki wanke ido da fata na aƙalla minti 15
say: Idan wani abu ya fantsama a idonki, ki wanke shi a ƙarƙashin ruwa mai tsabta mai gudu a hankali na aƙalla minti 15, kina riƙe fatar idon a buɗe.
A fata kuwa, ki cire kayan da suka jiƙe ki wanke haka nan. Kada ki taɓa amfani da ruwan tsami don kashe fantsamar.
Idan wani ya haɗiye kaya, kada ki sa shi amai. Ki kurkure bakinsa ki nemi taimakon likita nan take, tare da rubutun kayan.
Yanzu kin san dalilin da ya sa kaya ke tsabtacewa, yadda za ki ajiye kayan aikinki, da yadda za ki kare kanki.
Ki bi darussan da ke ƙasa, sannan ki yi ayyukan gwaji: taswirar dattinki, rajistar kayan aikinki da hoton wurin tsaronki.
